title: LINKSTART
tagline: We manage secret key at lit protocol and create AA（ERC4337） wallet from google account by stackup and access to web3 services and do web3 actions by its  AA wallet on LINKSTART.
description:
We manage secret key at lit protocol and create AA（ERC4337） wallet from google account by stackup and access to web3 services and do web3 actions by its  AA wallet on LINKSTART.
LIKSTART  wallet is super easy to create tied to own google account and LINKSTART explorer supports you to access to web3 world smoothly by its AA wallet.

By creating AA wallet from google account and LINKSTART explorer, LINKSTART onboard mainstream users into web3.
Exisiting wallet is a little be hard for mainstream users to set-up, manage secret key, and explore web3 world without any supports.
This is not enough onboarding experience. In our word, ’onboarding into web3’ means settling mainstream users in web3.

To build the ideel onboarding experience, we provide not only creating AA wallet from google account super easily, but also LINKSTART explore for mainstream users to show the right way to get into web3 and enjoy web3 world. Also, LINKSTART has action page where user can swap FT, trade NFT by very simple UI/UX by uniswap and opensea are running in backend.

Using LINKSTART, we can onboard next billion users to web3 without no fliction and  become a entrance and hub for mainstream users to access to web3 world, adding valuable web3 services on explorer page and web3 native actions on action page.In addition to that, more and more users use our explore, we can recommend dapps more and more personalized by token graph recommendation.

Here’s usecases and functions of LINKSTART
＜Usecase＞
😀users
user can access to basic web3 functions(token swap,NFT trade, NFT airdrop)  and web3 app/game super easily by LINKSTART.
🤓NFT projects
they can Airdrop to our mainstream users who do not have wallet.
😎web3 game/application
if they are on  our explorer page, they can access to mainstream users who do not have wallet.
😋businesses
they can onboard their users to web3  very smoothly by creating contract wallet from social id.

＜Function＞
🐶creating contract wallet from google account
・user do not have to manage secret key
🐱asset page：user can easily check own asset
・user can check own asset(FT/NFT)
🐭action page：user can easily do web3 actions
・token(FT) swap（uniswap run in the backend）
・NFT trade（opensea run in the backend）
🐹explorer：user can easily access to web3 services
・search engine（now）
・access to web3 services like opensea, uniswap and lens protocol easily on this page（coming soon）

※in near future, we definitely add another sign-up options like twitter, facebook and anything else.
